The estimated recoverable amount is USD 26,123.00.", "rebill_note_subject": "F-009 – Helix Arc Robotics LLC (C-2020): potential underbilling, missed escalation – for review", "rebill_note_body": "INTERNAL – NOT FOR CUSTOMER. Human approval required.

Finding F-009 | Customer: Helix Arc Robotics LLC | Contract: C-2020 | SKU: HTC-2003

Summary: The contractual annual price escalation was never applied in billing, resulting in potential underbilling of USD 26,123.00 across 12 invoice lines (2025-01-05 to 2025-12-05). Estimated recoverable: USD 26,123.00.

Basis: Clause A.1 (page 1) sets the price at USD 201.25 per unit. Clause 4.2 (page 1) provides a 3% Unit Price increase from 1 January 2025. Calculation: USD 201.25 x (1 + 3%) = USD 207.29 expected, versus USD 201.25 billed.

Proposed actions (owner: Pricing & Billing Master Data):
1. Load the escalated Unit Price into the billing price master from 2025-01-05.
2. Prepare a supplementary invoice for the under-billed lines for approval.

Please review and confirm before any rebilling is issued."}
